ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR24] Requires Billing Account on moving into Solutioning, Negotiation or Booking Verification, for ITAD cross-sell/upsell deals. Simplified per IRM feedback; 'ITAD' now used literally per IRM correction.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity' ),
ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'),
(ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'ITAD') && CONTAINS($Label.QTB_SITAD_Countries, QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c)) && NOT((ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed') && CloseDate < DATE(2024,04,19)) || ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Setup')),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ),
ISBLANK(Billing_Account__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Billing Account is required. Please select a Billing Account for this Opportunity.
